consequence.statement: The istioctl experimental injector list output now excludes webhooks not related to istio; no operational impact.

original.statement: istioctl experimental injector list no longer prints webhooks unrelated to istio (bug fix).

decision.reason: [ev-a486e34929cd] describes only a bugfix to the output of an experimental istioctl diagnostic command, which no longer prints webhooks unrelated to Istio. Nothing in the evidence says that anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. Cluster behaviour also stays the same. So "none" (informational) with low severity is the consequence the evidence supports. Calling it behavior-change, as P1 does, would mean guessing that some script parses this experimental output, which the evidence does not mention.
